# 📘 IGA IMPLEMENTATION – FULL SPECIFICATION

**System:** Workday → Salesforce
**Model:** User-Centric IGA
**Data Source:** Provided mock dataset

---

# 1. 🧠 Functional Model (Based on Your Data)

## 1.1 Core Objects

### 👤 Users (Identities)

* Represent **human identities**
* Managed via IGA lifecycle
* Loaded from the authoritative source (Workday)
    * Unique identifiers are employee IDs
    * Identities have their own email generated by the workday entry
    * Each identity have a mandatory reference to their manager


### 🏢 Accounts (Resources)

* Represent **business objects owned by users**, in our case it will be salesforce

# 3. ⚙️ IGA Technical Architecture

## 3.1 Components

### Source System

* Workday API (`/workday/employees`)

### Target System

* Salesforce API (`/salesforce/*`)

### IGA Engine (ESailPoint ISC)

Handles:

* Aggregation
* Correlation
* Provisioning
* Certification

---

# 4. 🔄 Identity Lifecycle (JML)

# 🔄 Identity Lifecycle Model (Target State)

We want 5 states:

```text
PRE-JOINER → JOINER → ACTIVE → INACTIVE → DELETED
```

---

# 1. 🧠 Lifecycle Definitions

## 1.1 PRE-JOINER

### 📌 Business Meaning

* User exists in Workday
* Has **not started yet** (start date in the future)

### 🔎 Detection Rule

```text
status = Active AND startDate > today
```

---

### ⚙️ IGA Behavior

| Action                  | Description         |
| ----------------------- | ------------------- |
| Identity created in IGA | ✅                   |
| Salesforce (SF) account      | ❌ (NOT created yet) |
| Access                  | ❌ None              |
| Notifications           | manager => new user in your team!  |

---

### 💡 Optional (Advanced)

* Pre-provision “shadow account” (disabled) *You can do that Afterwards, ou can pre-create the SF account in advance for now no need*
    * Also allow manager to request for their newly created member accesses

---

---

## 1.2 JOINER

### 📌 Business Meaning

* First day of employment

### 🔎 Detection Rule

```text
today == startDate
```

---

### ⚙️ IGA Behavior

| Action                     | Description |
| -------------------------- | ----------- |
| Create Salesforce user     | ✅           |
| Assign birthright access (Basic Permissions)   | ✅           |
| Allow users to request access   | ✅           |

---


## 1.3 ACTIVE

### 📌 Business Meaning

* Employee is fully active

### 🔎 Detection Rule

```text
status = Active AND startDate <= today AND (endDate is null OR endDate > today)
```

---

### ⚙️ IGA Behavior

| Action              | Description |
| ------------------- | ----------- |
| Maintain account    | ✅           |
| Enable accounts  | ✅           |
| Allow requests      | ✅           |
| Certification scope | ✅           |

---

### 🔁 Mover Logic (inside ACTIVE)

Triggered when:

* department / manager changes
* country or location changes

---

### ⚙️ Actions

| Change          | Action                   |
| --------------- | ------------------------ |
| Country / Location change | Update account values automatiacally + notify manager |
| department / manager change  | notify new manager |

---

## 1.4 INACTIVE (Leaver)

### 📌 Business Meaning

* Employee left or is suspended

### 🔎 Detection Rule

```text
status = Inactive OR endDate <= today
```

---

### ⚙️ IGA Behavior

| Action                   | Description  |
| ------------------------ | ------------ |
| Disable Salesforce user  | ✅            |
| Remove access (GroupIds) | ✅            |
| Remove Accounts        | ✅            |
| Reassign owned accounts  | ✅ (COMPLEXE / to be discussed) |

---

## 1.5 DELETED

### 📌 Business Meaning

* Company is obligated to remove madantory PII so the accounts should be removed.

---

### 🔎 Detection Rule

```text
Inactive for 30 days
```

---

### ⚙️ IGA Behavior

| Action                 | Description |
| ---------------------- | ----------- |
| Remove from Salesforce | ✅           |
| Change display name to "Deleted - <old_displayName>      | ✅           |


# 2. 🔁 Lifecycle State Machine (Important)

```text
PRE-JOINER
   ↓ (startDate reached)
JOINER
   ↓ (after provisioning)
ACTIVE
   ↓ (endDate reached / status inactive)
INACTIVE
   ↓ (retention period passed)
DELETED
```


# 4. 🔐 Access Strategy Per Lifecycle

| Lifecycle  | Access Level           |
| ---------- | ---------------------- |
| PRE-JOINER | ❌ None                 |
| JOINER     | ✅ Minimal (birthright) |
| ACTIVE     | ✅ Full                 |
| INACTIVE   | ❌ None                 |
| DELETED    | ❌ None                 |

---

# 5. 🧠 Birthright Access (JOINER)

Default groups from your dataset:

* Basic Permissions
* Reporting Users

---

# 6. ⚠️ Edge Cases You MUST Handle

## 6.1 Rehire Case

```text
INACTIVE → ACTIVE
```

👉 Actions:

* Reactivate user
* Reassign previous access OR recompute
